Vanessa / Marissa — I pushed a first-pass save plan into the shared drive and added a one-line summary in the CSV. TL;DR for DEAL-98431: RED (procurement hold + internal budget freeze). Proposed save plan below: 

1) Immediate: (Marcus) Obtain confirmation of the intake owner at Nimbus and get procurement timeline (ETA 48 hours).
2) Short-term: (Marissa) Coordinate an exec-to-exec call this week to unblock procurement — target Mon/Tue next week.
3) Financial: (Marcus + Finance Ops) Offer a split-payment option to reduce initial PO size; ask for a firm commitment to a 60-day activation window.
4) Contingency: If procurement requests >30 days, we convert to a staged delivery and hold 50% of the seat count pending signed SOW.

I recommend we loop Emily Stone (buyer) on the next email once we have the exec call date; we should not share the staged-delivery language until legal confirms. I flagged "exec escalation required" in the "hygiene_notes".

Attachments referenced: nimbus_save_plan_v1.pdf (draft, 512 KB)

—Marcus

- Marcus: finalize the save-playbook PDF (attached) and remove any non-essential negotiable items before we surface to the buyer. Share the single-slide ask for the exec meeting.
- Marissa: hold the forecast as zero-commit for DEAL-98431 until we get verbal exec commitment; update pipeline status and move to "red" in the CRM.
- Tom: can your team run a quick procurement check with our partner contacts? If ProcuPlus can confirm typical Nimbus procurement SLA we can use that in the exec ask.

I’m escalating this to the Revenue Ops huddle if we don’t get a concrete exec slot by tomorrow EOD. I want the following on the record: if we cannot secure a date, we pull DEAL-98431 from this quarter’s commit and shift it to next quarter forecast as upside.

Vanessa / team — thanks for the clear plan and for pulling the save-playbook together. Quick responses from our side: 

- Procurement is currently reviewing an internal headcount freeze; that’s the blocker. We can aim to have an internal decision by Dec 10.
- We are open to a split-payment arrangement but need a formal SOW and deliverable milestones. Can Marcus & Marissa share a one-pager of the proposed split terms (PO1 = 40% on signature / PO2 = remaining 60% on delivery milestone)?
- For the exec call, I can make time the week of Dec 13 — Emily (buyer) + Mike (CTO) would attend. If you can lock dates, I’ll prioritize scheduling.

Appreciate the fast follow-up — Emily
